g.text: So how'd you end up getting involved in the whole Arthur/Hex thing?
You seem to really... REALLY hate Entrati. Why?
Worse than the bloodbath where Arthur and I became hermanos
I promised to follow him anywhere
Seems like he meant to the edge of Mictlán
If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
No problem. Plenty of shit I haven't told you, yet.
We were stationed together in the same base
Him in the Britannic and me with the Libertatian Army
I was the field medic for my regiment
We were deployed in next to his
But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned his family
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned his family
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
But after everything you told me
How could I not hate that cabrón?!
You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time
We all have the things we don't tell people
Until we're very certain we can trust them not to change how they feel
Most of my crew didn't make it
I stitched his arm up good jaja
When he retired and went into the ICR
I was sick of all the drama that goes on in the army anyway
The way you talk about him, and because I know how much trust is important to you... It seems personal.
I know how much you hate it when people break the trust of others. Especially animals.
People who hurt animals have a special place in hell, absolutely. But it seems like there's more going on than that.
Yeah, but it seems like a personal grudge you have against him.
The way you talk about him, and because I know how much trust is important to you... It seems personal.
Yeah, but it seems like a personal grudge you have against him.
It might change how you look at some of us babas
And I don't know if I trust you enough not to walk away
Do you not trust me yet?
We've all made mistakes in life. I'm sure it can't be that bad.
Careful, or else I might start to think you're getting attached to me.
Then what? How'd you get to be...
War sucks. No matter when, no matter how.
Our wars must seem so small
Yours sound tan espectaculares y llamativas
Filled with dioses, ángeles y demonios
Need a new nickname for you, ¿eh babas? Jaja
Animals most of all deserve the best we can give them
And when trust is broken like that
It makes me want to kill a man
Can I ask what he did?
If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
Ese cabrón se puede ir brincando a la chingada
Gotten used to having you underfoot, babas
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head
Or maybe I'm just happy to have someone around who is useful babas
You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time
Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head
Is that what you think you are?
But I guess in the end it's all the same
People dying in the muck and mud
And La Flaca takes them home
If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
Not something I want to get into
I don't recall voting on it
Sounds like you made it up
I don't recall voting on it
I don't know what he did to you, but... sounds like it was rough.
Can I ask what he did?
I get it. Not a problem.
Like that stitched together creature from that book
How'd you wind up meeting Entrati, though?
Can I ask what happened next?
You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time
Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head
Has no one told you what happened?
But I get what you're asking
And you've been dancing around the subject like you want to do the tango
You know I don't want to talk about it
Has no one told you what happened?
Not something I want to get into
Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head
I'm just trying to get the whole picture.
No one else will tell me. They just avoid the subject.
I figured you'd be the one to give me a straight answer.
I get it. Not a problem.
You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.
Well, I think rats are intelligent, social, adorable wonderful animals...
Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza
Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza
Tossed aside when the use was done
Dangerous if left to spread their diseases
And if nobody else will tell you I guess it's up to Mamá Lettie
Well this story is one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot
And figure Mamá Lettie would tell you the truth
But this one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot
This one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot
What do you mean, "spread their diseases?"
A lab rat isn't to blame for the things the scientists force on them.
But it doesn't mean they should be allowed to spread their diseases
You know how to make me smile
But it doesn't mean they should be allowed to spread their diseases
You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.
Then what're you suggesting we do? Put you all down?
Might miss you if you leave
And this story might make you turn and go
So a story for another day
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza
Tossed aside when the use was done
Dangerous if left to spread their diseases
If we weren't trapped in this loop
You'd have to or we'd go mad like the bruja metiche did in that nightmare
That Entrati cabrón deserves to die a slow and painful death
And I hope I get to be the one that delivers him to La Flaca personally
That Entrati cabrón deserves to die a slow and painful death
And I hope I get to be the one that delivers him to La Flaca personally
What do you mean, "spread their diseases?"
You're not to blame for any of this, Lettie.
Well, with transference it could be slowed...
Pero it's not a story I'm telling today
And too much shit in that story for today
Back to work for both of us
I don't need protecting, you should know that by now
That Entrati cabrón deserves to die a slow and painful death
And I hope I get to be the one that delivers him to La Flaca personally
Pero it's not a story I'm telling today
And too much shit in that story for today
Back to work for both of us
Trapped here we cannot do much harm anymore
Back to work for both of us
